title: Coffee is cold in 90 minutes. Iced tea stays cold a long time
text:
Coffee is cold in 90 minutes. Iced tea stays cold a long time. I had hoped this cup would work for my husband when he's on the road and needs hot coffee. However, he has given it back to me after three days with the comment "nope". Apparently, the claim of keeping hot drinks hot for up to six hours is an exaggeration. After 90 minutes the coffee is actually cold. That's not good.

I will say that keeping sweet tea cold for three hours was no problem at all. The cup does fit in the cup holders of the F-150 truck and the rubber grip is definitely nice. This one doesn't slip out of my hand if I'm driving or walking. I'm just keeping this for cold drinks and still looking for a coffee cup for my husband.

Cross-country Road trip? you'll be happy to know that your tumbler easily fits most car cup holders. The nonslip silicone grip means you'll feel secure carrying this travel mug while on the go. At the end of the day, throw lid and body onto the top rack of your dishwasher for a no-fuss cleanup. Rest assured, your bubba is guaranteed for life.
